artifacts.summary: 7-phase, 5.5-hour plan covering all 6 work items and all 5 acceptance criteria: env re-confirmation, stale-doc correction, export-freshness gating, DOI-normalized live dedup, invariant-preservation evidence, user-gated live envelope confirmation, and first-time extension activation plus deploy with byte-identity verification.

completion_data.completion_summary: Created the implementation plan. Phase structure: (1) re-confirm zot v0.10.0 / API key scope / deployed-tree gap and capture the zot schema surface; (2) correct stale docs across README, zotero-write.sh header, zotero-scripts.md, zotero-item-creation.md, zotero-integration.md; (3) wire zotero-export-freshness.sh into both write branches of literature-ingest-online.sh as re-verify-then-proceed; (4) add normalize_doi() plus a hard-stop live-library DOI dedup via zotero-read.sh search with exact .data[].doi equality; (5) evidence-based verification that the %PDF gate, DOI-only-fallback honest surfacing, never-fabricate-keys stop, and the zotero-write.sh choke-point are unchanged; (6) user-gated real item-add and attach-file against the production library to confirm envelope field paths, with [COMPLETED WITH EXCLUSIONS] as the sanctioned outcome if the gate is declined; (7) first-time extension activation via a one-off headless manager.load('literature', {confirm=false}) call, resync, byte-identity verification, and post-deploy reconciliation of the deployment-status table.

known_deviations: Work item 3 is re-scoped per follow-up research: the entire literature extension is absent from the deployed .claude/ tree and untracked in .claude-extensions.json (re-confirmed live at plan time: keys are core,email,memory,nix,nvim). deploy-headless.sh's default mode only resyncs currently-active extensions, so Phase 7 performs first-time activation before any resync.

Phase 7 chooses the headless manager.load('literature', {confirm=false}) option over adding a --load flag to deploy-headless.sh. Rationale: activation is an operation, not a source edit, so it needs no change to core-extension scripted infrastructure and keeps every edit inside agent-system/extensions/literature/** per the binding source-store rule. The interactive <leader>al picker is named as the sanctioned fallback.

Phase 7's activation blast radius is materially larger than 'three scripts': 1 agent, 2 commands, 2 skills, 2 context roots, 36 scripts, and a merge-sources/claudemd.md merge that adds the --lit section to the generated CLAUDE.md. The phase requires presenting this to the user before activating.

Phase 6 performs a real, hard-to-reverse write into the user's 904-item production Zotero library and carries a hard user-confirmation gate before the first non-dry-run call. Declining the gate is an accepted outcome that closes the phase [COMPLETED WITH EXCLUSIONS], which acceptance criterion 2 explicitly permits ('or documents exactly why confirmation is still pending').

Work item 4's 'refuse OR re-verify' is planned as re-verify-then-proceed rather than unconditional refusal, because the export is persistently stale in this environment (still ZOTERO_EXPORT_STALE) and an unconditional refusal would block all ingest. The Phase 4 live-library DOI check is the concrete re-verification mechanism.
Phases 3 and 4 both edit literature-ingest-online.sh and are deliberately serialized (Phase 4 depends on 3) rather than parallelized, to avoid conflicting edits to the same file.
